facts.fact: A Land at Scale pilot with Oxfam, Kadaster International and FAO equips the cadastre directorate with tablets and GNSS receivers in two pilot zones, N'Djamena 7th arrondissement and Linia, and the data collected will feed the base of the land one-stop shop (GIRAF), the ministry (MATUH) saying it is not a land registration.

systems.owner: Ministere de l'Amenagement du Territoire, de l'Urbanisme et de l'Habitat

facts.fact: Land minister Mahamat Assileck Halata said on 21 December 2022 that GIRAF, the online land-document processing system, was fully restored and operational, allowing the land one-stop shop to reopen.

systems.owner: Ministere de l'Amenagement du territoire, de l'habitat et de l'urbanisme
